pr_title: Feature: Enabled tags by default and removed option to turn them off
pr_body:
**Resolved*
- Closes #9586 

**Details of Changes**
-Removed Tag ToggleSwitch
-Removed all the code that was executed at change of the toggle status
-Removed all the ifs that checked if tags were enabled (Now their code is always executed)

**Validation**
- Built and ran the app, everything worked fine
pr_comments: As noted in the issue, we're not ready to merge this just yet, let's keep this open in the meantime.

@ferrariofilippo last thing, can you add the link icon back to the edit button? It should look like this.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39923744/185474986-a30897b6-3066-4aaa-835c-3bf0d816c704.png)
@ferrariofilippo excellent work! Thank you for contributing to Files, this change will be included in the next release.

issue_context.title: Turn tags on by default and remove setting to turn it off
issue_context.body: We're getting close to the point where tags can leave preview and we can remove the setting to disable it. We should hold off on this a bit longer but I'm opening this issue to keep track.
comments:
Before this I believe we need a way to:
- allow the user to hide the "Tags" column from all folders at once
- allow the user to edit tags as #9710 also removes the "edit tags" command

review_comments: Should we still have the null check?

Just checked, the property still return 'null' if there are no tags selected.
Functions that use this property check if the value is null
